description: Meteor retired 30 December 1970 and given to the school (then ENET Haedo); kept in running condition with engines occasionally started. Identity conflict: Wikipedia's survivor list gives I-071 painted as C-073, while Roll Out (Nov 2018) gives G-5-173/I-073 painted C-071 — but I-073 is the Mar del Plata gate guard per Núñez Padín and es.wikipedia also gives this airframe as C-071 wearing C-073, so I-071 is recorded here. Reported November 2018, 2021 and July 2026.
aliases: Meteor F4; Meteor F Mk 4; C-071; C-073; I-073; C071; C073; I073
